fonts.display: 'ui-sans-serif', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Suisse Intl', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Pure White
palette.role: Page canvas, input fields, inverse text on dark surfaces

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Primary text, headlines, body copy, nav links — near-black warmth over pure black

palette.name: True Black
palette.role: Logo mark fill, select borders, deep shadow tone

palette.name: Hairline
palette.role: Borders, dividers, outlined control strokes, card edges

palette.name: Fog
palette.role: Secondary card surfaces, disabled button fills, subtle elevation layers

palette.name: Cream Stone
palette.role: Warm accent card surface — the only chromatic neutral, used for editorial feature cards

palette.name: Muted
palette.role: Secondary link color, meta text, subdued captions

palette.name: Disabled
palette.role: Disabled button backgrounds, inactive control fills

palette.name: Electric Yellow
palette.role: Announcement bar, single chromatic accent across the system — the only color permitted to break monochrome
